system.description:
Unit type. Discipline modifier +3. Key abilities: Athletics, Endurance, Fighting.

Also reduce Wealth: Green –1, Trained –3, Veteran –6, Elite –9.

Training adds to the cost (enter it as a Feature): Green +1 (Discipline Challenging 9, 20 XP) · Trained +3 (Routine 6, 60 XP) · Veteran +5 (Easy 3, 100 XP) · Elite +7 (Automatic 0, 140 XP). Each unit is 100 men, 20 horse or 5 ships.

SIFRP p. 111
